description: This file defines the OutputStyle class in the ScssPhp namespace, encapsulating constants and methods related to output styling (expanded or compressed) in the SCSS to CSS compilation process.

classes.name: OutputStyle
classes.description: Final class representing output styles with static methods to convert to/from string representations.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a string ('expanded' or 'compressed') to the corresponding OutputStyle constant.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts an OutputStyle constant to its string representation.
